verdict.rationale: Error tracking is a fair axis for an observability platform, so it applies. The pack does not document what the story asks for. Frontend Observability is said to capture errors, but nothing shows errors grouped into issues, stack traces, release tracking, or regression detection. Generic logs, traces and alerting are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see application errors grouped into issues with stack traces, release tracking, and regression detection
